text: Hello, boys and girls, welcome back to our English class.Summer is around the corner.You will wear your summer uniforms soon.Do you remember what your winter uniforms look like?Do you like them?In this lesson, you are going to read a text about the winter uniforms in Rose Garden School.Before we start our lesson, please check if you have these things.Your student's book, your notebook, worksheets and pens.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,学习单和笔。Shall we begin?In our last lesson, we read a notice about the summer uniforms in Rose Garden School.Look at the pictures.Let's talk about their summer uniforms again.When must all students wear summer uniforms?All students must wear summer uniforms in September, early October, late April, May and June.What kind of uniforms must boys wear in summer?Boys must wear white shirts with short sleeves, blue shorts, black belts, white socks and black shoes.What kind of uniforms must girls wear in summer?Girls must wear white dresses with short sleeves, blue belts, white socks and black shoes.What else must all students wear?All students must wear red scarves.Excellent.From the notice, we know when students must wear their summer uniforms, what kind of uniforms they must wear in summer and what else they all must wear.Now, Ms.Guo is writing a notice to all new students about their uniforms in winter.Please think it over.What information may change in the notice?Perhaps the time may change.Maybe the style of the uniforms changes as well.Now, please open your student's book and turn to page 41.Read the notice.Compare it with the notice on page 40.Find out the differences.Underline the different parts while reading.You will have two minutes to read.Start.冰糖米粉黄酒盐盐盐盐盐盐盐盐盐盐盐Time is up.Did you find any differences?Yes, the title is different.Anything else?Very good.The mouth are different too.Yes, the style of the uniforms.Look at these two pictures.Please find out the differences between the boys' summer uniforms and their winter uniforms in Rose Garden School.The picture on the left shows Peter's summer uniform, and the one on the right shows his winter uniform.Look, the first difference is a red jacket.Peter is wearing a red jacket in the picture on the right.Can you guess the meaning of jacket?It means 短款外套,夾克衫。Please read after me.Jacket.Again.Good.Any other differences?Boys seldom wear shorts in winter.It's cold.So Peter is wearing a pair of grey trousers in the picture on the right.Can you tell the meaning of trousers?It means 長褲.Trousers.Can you find more differences?In winter, do boys still wear white shirts with the short sleeves?I don't think so.So think about it.What kind of shirts do boys wear in winter?Correct.Peter is wearing a white shirt with the long sleeves in the picture on the right.A white shirt with the long sleeves.Now, please take out your worksheet.In task one, you can find girls' uniform in winter on the right.Look at Kitty in the picture.What is her uniform made up of?If there are some new words you don't know, try to finish the task with the help of colours.Write letters A to E in the correct boxes.You will have one minute to finish the task.Time is up.Let's check the answers.A should be put into the first box on the left.B should be put into the third box on the right.C should be put into the second box on the left.What about D?A white blouse with the long sleeves.Where should we put it?Yes, D should be put into the first box on the right.Here is a new word.A blouse is a kind of shirt that a girl or a woman wears.It means 女士衬衫。Blouse.So the last one, E, should be put into the second box on the right.Look at the picture.Can you guess the meaning of skirt?Yes, it means 女裙.Skirt.Did you get all the answers right?Now, can you describe Kitty's winter uniform by yourself?From what we learned in last lesson, we know that when we talk about our uniforms, we should describe them from our heads to our feet and from the inside to the outside.Use the words you learned in task 1.You may begin the sentence with Kitty is wearing.You will have 30 seconds to get prepared.What is Kitty wearing?Kitty is wearing a white blouse with long sleeves, a grey skirt, a red jacket, a pair of grey socks, and a pair of black shoes.Good job.Now, please complete the notice for Miss Guo on your book.Boys must wear white shirts with long sleeves, grey trousers, red jackets, grey socks, and black shoes.Girls must wear white blouses with long sleeves, grey skirts, red jackets, grey socks, and black shoes.Now, read the notice again and answer the following questions.When must all students wear winter uniforms?What kind of uniforms must boys wear in winter?What kind of uniforms must girls wear in winter?What must all students wear all the time?You can underline the answers while reading.Start now.Yes, all students must wear winter uniforms in late November, December, January, February, March, and early April.You can find the answer in paragraph 1.Do you still remember what late November means?We call the last 10 days in November late November.What about early April?We call the first 10 days in April early April.Here, please pay attention.All students start their new school year in September.That's why Miss Guo wrote late November first.What else must all students wear all the time?You can find the answer in the last paragraph.Now, please read the text aloud after me.Miss Guo is writing a notice to all new students about their uniforms in winter.Rose Garden School to all new studentsUniforms in winterAll students must wear winter uniforms in late November, December, January, February, March, and early April.Look at task 2.There is a picture of the winter uniforms in my school.Write a notice to all new students about their uniforms in winter.Don't forget the title.You will have two minutes to finish the task.【翻译】时间到了Jimmy是我的学生他送了我他的读书我们一起读书看看他做得怎么样Happy school to all new studentsUniforms in winterAll students must wear winter uniforms in late November, December, January, February, March and early April.Boys must wear white shirts with the long sleeves, blue trousers, blue jackets, white socks and white shoes.Girls must wear white blouses with the long sleeves, blue skirts, blue jackets, white socks and black shoes.Did Jimmy write a title?Yes, he did.Did Jimmy tell all new students when they must wear their winter uniforms?Did Jimmy describe the uniforms from head to feet and from the inside to the outside?Did Jimmy tell all new students to wear red scarves?Look, Jimmy did a very good job.You surely did a very good job too.Let's sum up.Today, we helped Miss Guo complete the notice about the winter uniforms in Rose Garden School.I hope you can use what you've learned to talk about as well as write about your school uniforms.After class, please finish the exercises on your homework sheet.So much for today.See you next time.Thank you for watching.
